description: This Java class provides services related to tax calculations within the OFBiz framework, specifically for handling tax adjustments, retrieving tax authorities, and calculating product taxes for display and order processing.

classes.name: TaxAuthorityServices
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating and adjusting taxes based on product, order, and geographic information within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalcForDisplay
methods.description: Calculates the total tax, tax percentage, and price with tax for a product, formatted for display purposes.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates tax adjustments for an order or order items, considering shipping, promotions, and geographic tax authorities.

methods.name: getTaxAuthorities
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax authorities based on shipping address geographic regions.

methods.name: getTaxAdjustments
methods.description: Generates tax adjustment entries based on product, store, and order details, including tax rates and exemptions.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Fetches the product price considering tax authority and store group context.

methods.name: setProductCategoryCond
methods.description: Determines the product category condition for tax calculations based on product variant status.

methods.name: handlePartyTaxExempt
methods.description: Checks and applies tax exemption status for a party, including inherited exemptions from parent tax authorities.
